name: Ravissante
summary: Ravissante is crowned with a grey marble top, its natural veining bringing depth and quiet drama to the design. The structure is finished in matte black, creating a striking contrast against a polished stainless steel inner base. The outer layer, plated in brushed black nickel, adds a subtle gleam and contemporary edge. Powerful yet elegant, it embodies modern luxury with a sculptural presence that commands attention. 240x110x76
